name: Eurofins Scientific SE

corporate_actions.event: Muddy Waters short report (related-party real estate, acquisition accounting, governance); Eurofins rejected claims (25-Jun and 3-Jul-2024), published related-party lease benchmarks and commissioned EY Paris forensic review (22-Oct-2024) which it said found acquisition multiples for businesses with related-party real estate in line with/below average
Acquisition of Element Materials Technology life-sciences testing business (value not extracted); acquired revenue to exceed EUR250m annualised target
Q3 2026: revenue EUR1,913m (+6.1%), organic accelerating to 3.5%; FY26 organic objective lowered below 'single-digit average' target; 2027 objectives confirmed

geography.fx_notes: Approx. Europe ~50% / North America ~40% / RoW ~10% (PitchBook/Morningstar profile description, rounded - ESTIMATE). Activity mix ~40% food/feed/environment, ~30% BioPharma, ~20% clinical diagnostics, ~10% consumer & technology products.

kpis.value: Programme to own sites (reducing related-party leases); amount not extracted

kpis.value: EUR149/sqm vs EUR165/sqm third-party (2023 AR, per company rebuttal)

company_fcf.definition: Free cash flow to the firm before investment in owned sites

lease.source_id: IFRS filer; lease payments include leases from founder-related entities; not extracted - data gap

acquisitions.notes: Element life-sciences testing; >EUR250m annualised acquired revenue in 2026

management.ceo: Gilles Martin (founder, CEO since 1988 per recall)
management.senior_turnover_5y: Founder-led; frequent changes in CFO/IR historically (recall, L)
management.guidance_record: Mixed: 2026 organic objective cut (Oct-26); 2027 objectives confirmed; FY25 objectives met

ownership.controlling_holders: Martin family via Analytical Bioventures SCA - large minority of capital (~1/3) and majority of voting rights via multiple-voting shares (recall, not re-verified)

activists.name: Muddy Waters (short seller)
activists.objective: Short position; alleged related-party real estate abuse and accounting issues
activists.company_response: Rejected; published rebuttals and EY forensic review (Oct-2024)

ownership.board_independence: Founder-controlled; independence below CAC 40 norms (recall, L)
ownership.related_party: Laboratory sites leased from entities owned by Dr Martin and another executive (Mr Linde) - company says arm's-length (rent below third-party average); programme to buy sites

guidance.value: Below 'single-digit average' (mid-single-digit) target; acquired revenue > EUR250m annualised; profitability and cash-flow objectives maintained
Return to average single-digit organic growth; medium-term objectives confirmed

evidence: BioPharma services and clinical diagnostics more volatile (COVID boom/bust 2020-23)
Leadership in food and environment testing
Adj. EBITDA margin 22.5% but EBIT margin ~12% (provider) - heavy D&A from lab build-out
C.rationale: Scale with unclear returns on large capex.

evidence: Regulation expansion (PFAS, food safety), biopharma outsourcing
Large historical capex and M&A with modest ROIC

H.rationale: Related-party structure and control weaken minority protection.

evidence: Physical lab testing; some discovery services exposed to in-silico methods
Consumer & technology products ~10%; no DC linkage
Persistent 'separately disclosed items'; adjusted vs reported EBITDA gap

sector_specific.short_seller_history: Muddy Waters Jun-2024 (rebutted; EY forensic Oct-2024)

gates.notes: G2 = B: related-party real-estate leases from founder entities and 2024 short-seller allegations - company rebuttal/EY forensic review, no regulator investigation or restatement identified (open questions, not 'material abuse'). G1: company 2.2x; provider 2.5x. G4: lead to verify FCF after owned-site capex vs NI (EUR~560m).

bull_points: Global leader in regulated food/environment testing with structural regulatory tailwinds (e.g., PFAS).
Organic re-accelerating (3.5% Q3-26) with margin expansion and buybacks.
bear_points: Governance: founder voting control plus related-party leases; credibility risk from 2024 short report.
Organic growth repeatedly below mid-term target; 2026 objective cut.
Heavy capex/acquisition model with modest EBIT margins vs TIC peers.
thesis_breakers: Any regulatory investigation, auditor qualification or restatement (G2 -> A).
